description.en: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListImageTransforms](~~2869056~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

description.zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
- global：查询全局配置；
- rule：查询规则配置；

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置。
description.en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:
- global: queries global configurations.
- rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If not specified, both global and rule configurations are returned.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1。
description.en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500。
description.en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

description.zh: 站点ID。可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口查询获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
description.en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0.

title.zh: 查询多条站点图片转换配置
title.en: Query image transformation configurations for a site

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-image-transforms --site-id 1234560000 --config-id 352816096987136 --config-type global --rule-name test1 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --site-version 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListImageTransforms --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --ConfigId 352816096987136 --ConfigType global --SiteVersion 1 --RuleName test1
